blind.description: A rectangular stone chest tomb decorated on the sides with gothic arched reliefs and corner shield pilasters. The carved stone lid features a recumbent medieval knight in full plate armor and helmet resting his head on a pillow, with hands placed over a longsword lying down the center of his body. The model is rendered in a stylized, hand-painted stone material in muted slate-grey and purple tones. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and continuous, with no detached or broken geometry, and the flat base sits directly on the floor.
blind.from_above: A clean rectangular stone slab framed by beveled border blocks, inside which lies a sculpted knight in plate armor resting on his back with his helmeted head on a bolster and a straight sword running lengthwise between his legs.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 to 3 feet tall (just under half the figure's height), roughly 5.5 to 6 feet long, and about 2.5 to 3 feet wide.
